description: Source file for ProgressChartPresenter class in an Android Kotlin project. Defines a presenter that renders a bar chart for weekly calorie intake using Canvas drawing on a Bitmap, displayed via ImageCardView.

classes.name: ProgressChartPresenter
classes.description: A Presenter class in an Android project responsible for rendering a bar chart representing weekly calorie data. It creates a bitmap, draws axes and bars based on ProgressEntry data, and sets the bitmap to an ImageCardView.

methods.name: onCreateViewHolder
methods.description: Creates and configures an ImageCardView for displaying the chart, setting focus behavior, dimensions, and textual titles.

methods.name: onBindViewHolder
methods.description: Binds data to the view by creating a bitmap, drawing axes and bars representing calorie entries for last 7 days, and updating the ImageCardView with the bitmap.

methods.name: onUnbindViewHolder
methods.description: Cleans up the view by clearing the bitmap image from the ImageCardView.
